cues: Blende is a sulphide, so it too is concentrated by froth flotation.
It is then roasted in air at about twelve hundred kelvin to zinc oxide.
The sulphur dioxide is not wasted: it goes to make sulphuric acid.
text: Blende is a sulphide, so it too is concentrated by froth flotation. It is then roasted in air at about twelve hundred kelvin to zinc oxide. Calamine is simply calcined. The sulphur dioxide is not wasted: it goes to make sulphuric acid.
